summary: Verified the navCache-based shop navigation fix. Direct navigation to /member-shop-details?shopId=100070&categoryId=100001&source=user and /shop-details?shopId=999999&source=user both render WITHOUT any `shopData` JSON blob in the URL, and gracefully show a fallback ('Unable to load shop details' / 'Shop details unavailable') when the nav cache is empty and the upstream API is unreachable. No crashes. /my-orders and /merchant-orders continue to render (unaffected). Code review confirms all 5 senders (user-dashboard, member-dashboard, dual-dashboard, member-shop-list, map) now call setNavShop(shop) then router.push with only shopId/categoryId/source, and both consumers (member-shop-details, shop-details) prefer getNavShop() with a legacy shopData param fallback + API fetch fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: navCache.ts uses `memoryCache.__current` as a sentinel key inside a Record<string, Shop>. Iterating over `Object.keys(memoryCache)` would include '__current' — currently no code does that, but consider using a Map or a separate variable to avoid future foot-guns.

getNavShop's fallback to `__current` returns the last-set shop even if a mismatched id is provided (when the id key isn't in memory but current has a different id, it correctly rejects — but if key is null it returns current). This is intentional per the docstring but worth calling out.

member-shop-details.tsx still parses `shopDataParam` (legacy fallback). Once you confirm no old deep-link URLs are in circulation (e.g., emailed/shared links), you can drop this branch to shrink the bundle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary acceptance criterion (no `shopData=%7B...%7D` in URL) is verified. Real end-to-end click on a nearby shop card could NOT be exercised on the Emergent preview because the upstream nearby-shops API (https://devapi.intownlocal.com) blocks CORS from the preview origin, so the 'INtown Previlage Nearby Shops' carousel stays empty. The code path is verified by grep + fallback render on direct URL. If needed on a real device/build, the mobile app will populate the carousel and clicking a card will call setNavShop + router.push with only shopId/categoryId/source.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verifies a fix, no bug found.
